summary: v3 multi-city + document upload features fully tested. 32/32 pytest tests pass (10 schools + 7 city + 5 upload + 4 auth + 3 applications + 3 favourites). Frontend: city switcher changes hero text, top schools and schools list filter by city (verified Mumbai 35 / Bangalore 15 / Delhi 10 / Noida 10 / Gurgaon 10). Dashboard upload flow works end-to-end: file uploads via Emergent Object Storage, filename + size render, Remove clears metadata back to pending with toast.
critical_code_review_comments: DEFAULT_DOCS still uses module-level uuid.uuid4().hex[:10] — same 5 doc_ids reused across every application created by the server process. Within a single application the 5 ids are unique (no collision in upload lookup), but two different applications share identical doc_ids. Cosmetic only; recommend a factory function that regenerates per-call to make doc_ids globally unique and avoid future bugs if doc_ids are ever cross-referenced.

download_document_file accepts auth via ?auth= query param (used by tags). This is necessary for browser image preview, but tokens may end up in server access logs. Consider supporting a short-lived signed download URL in future.

Backend storage init is best-effort on startup and reinitialised on demand; storage_put/get blocking requests run inside async endpoint — fine for small files but for 8MB uploads they will block the event loop. Acceptable for MVP. Recommend `run_in_threadpool` or an async http client if traffic grows.
schools_meta still hardcodes facilities list rather than aggregating from DB.
